name: Stygian-Mausoleum
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a nearby asteroid belt, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
